channel.title: AR — daily AI/ML digest
channel.description: Curated AI/ML research and releases with what/why/who summaries.

item.title: [AINews] Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro 1T-A42B: the new top Open Weights model, trained for $3M
item.description:
What: A new open-weights language model featuring one trillion total parameters.

Why: It delivers frontier-class performance achieved with a highly efficient three-million-dollar training budget.

Who: Xiaomi

Latent Space · importance 4/5 · llm, foundational-models

item.title: Generalized Multimodal Foundation Model
item.description:
What: A unified foundation architecture capable of processing arbitrary modality combinations and prediction tasks.

Why: It bypasses task-specific fine-tuning by learning transferable correlations from large-scale synthetic multimodal datasets.

Who: Huizi Cui, Zongbo Han, Chenggong Ding et al.

arXiv cs.LG · importance 4/5 · foundational-models, multimodal

item.title: A Shared Learning Rate Is Not a Neutral Control in Selective On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
What: An empirical study analyzing how shared learning rates unfairly distort evaluations in selective on-policy knowledge distillation.

Why: It proves that baseline comparison protocols are fundamentally flawed due to selector-rate entanglement, invalidating prior experimental conclusions.

Who: Chencheng Zhu

arXiv cs.LG · importance 4/5 · llm, general-ml

item.title: Recognition, Simulation, and Refusal: A Contamination-Aware Study of Classic Psychological Effects in LLM Agents
item.description:
What: A benchmark and evaluation framework assessing whether language model agents genuinely exhibit human psychological biases or merely mimic them due to prompt contamination.

Why: It demonstrates that apparent behavioral biases in models stem from distinct mechanisms like label gating and safety refusals rather than true cognitive traits.

Who: Joy Bose

arXiv cs.CL · importance 4/5 · llm, ai-safety

item.title: Summarize, Judge, Refine: Decoupled Content Understanding and Policy Learning for Multimodal Content Moderation
item.description:
What: A decoupled moderation framework using a multimodal summarizer paired with a text-based policy classifier.

Why: It enables zero-shot policy bootstrapping and text-space augmentation, bypassing raw multimedia data scarcity.

Who: Zeeshan Ahmed, Yang Qin, Hanqing Huang

arXiv cs.CL · importance 4/5 · multimodal, reinforcement-learning, interpretability

item.title: Transferring the Intelligence of VLMs to Robotic Control
item.description:
What: A framework called RoboDawn that interfaces vision-language models with robotic control using discrete action commands.

Why: It enables zero-shot and few-shot robotic manipulation without task-specific training, outperforming some specialized baselines.

Who: Meng-Hao Guo, Zhe-Han Mo, Jia-Jun Wang et al.

Hugging Face Papers · importance 4/5 · robotics, multimodal

item.title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
item.description:
What: This paper introduces WorldCrafter, a video world model utilizing implicit 3D-aware memory.

Why: It compresses historical observations into target-view tokens to enable long-horizon, camera-controlled scene exploration without explicit depth mapping.

Who: Wangbo Yu, Kunhao Liu, Wenbo Hu et al.

Hugging Face Papers · importance 4/5 · world-models, simulation

item.title: GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation in Gameplay
item.description:
What: A multi-horizon dataset and evaluation suite designed to benchmark AI models across 21 complex video games.

Why: It provides 5,000 hours of expert gameplay data paired with standardized offline and online testing pipelines.

Who: Yiran Wang, Xingyilang Yin, Junfu Pu et al.

Hugging Face Papers · importance 4/5 · multimodal, general-ml

item.title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
item.description:
What: A framework for automatically optimizing LLM agent harnesses using regularized evolutionary search.

Why: It prevents agents from overfitting to benchmark tasks, improving out-of-distribution generalization while using 30% fewer tokens.

Who: Google Research

Hugging Face Papers · importance 4/5 · llm

item.title: Grok 4.7
item.description:
What: SpaceXAI announced Grok 4.7, an upgraded large language model optimized for complex coding and extended knowledge tasks.

Why: It features a larger base architecture trained with longer reinforcement learning to improve self-verification, context management, and cost efficiency.

Who: SpaceXAI

Hacker News · importance 4/5 · llm, foundational-models, reinforcement-learning

item.title: Detecting Hallucination in LLMs: Tracing the Topological Signatures of Impaired Context Sharing
item.description:
What: This paper introduces a single-pass method to detect LLM hallucinations by analyzing attention graph topology.

Why: It reveals that hallucinations are linked to impaired context sharing and information bottlenecks in final transformer layers.

Who: Amir Jalilifard, Anderson Rocha, Eric Wong et al.

arXiv cs.AI · importance 3/5 · llm, interpretability, ai-safety

item.title: Decoupling Internal Representational Changes and Causal Importance in Fine-Tuned Large Language Models
item.description:
What: This paper analyzes how fine-tuning modifies the internal representations and causal mechanisms of LLMs.

Why: It demonstrates that layers with the most significant representational changes do not align with those causally driving task performance.

Who: Lingfang Li, Procheta Sen, Shubham Das et al.

arXiv cs.AI · importance 3/5 · llm, interpretability

item.title: TinyCeNN-LM: Quality-Gated Conversion of Pretrained Attention with CeNN-Inspired Cellular-Recurrent Layers
item.description:
What: A framework for selectively replacing attention layers in pretrained language models with cellular-recurrent modules.

Why: It reduces KV cache requirements while preserving model fidelity using strict quality-gated validation thresholds.

Who: Kabeh Mohsenzadegan, Vahid Tavakkoli, Kyandoghere Kyamakya

arXiv cs.AI · importance 3/5 · llm

item.title: Clinician-Grounded Quality Assurance for AI-Assisted Psychiatric Intake
item.description:
What: An evaluation platform utilizing memory-augmented patient simulators to assess AI psychiatric intake tools.

Why: It addresses hospital quality assurance needs by measuring clinical information recovery, hallucination risks, and safety handling during mental health interviews.

Who: King Shi, Amanda Li, Jonathan Ivey et al.

arXiv cs.AI · importance 3/5 · llm, ai-safety, simulation

item.title: PRQuant: Permutation Residual Quantization for Low-Overhead Inference
item.description:
What: PRQuant is a training-free post-training quantization method that reorganizes channels and applies static residual compensation to accelerate low-bit linear layer inference.

Why: It eliminates expensive online activation gathering operations during runtime, achieving better accuracy than standard MXFP4 while lowering latency.

Who: Peiran Wang, Anqi Wang, Jiaying Zhao et al.

arXiv cs.LG · importance 3/5 · llm, training-infra

item.title: Correcting Learning-based Perception for Safety
item.description:
What: A dual-stage framework that maps machine learning perception uncertainties offline and applies a risk-aware runtime filter for safer autonomous control.

Why: It significantly reduces safety failures in vision-based systems under varying environmental conditions without introducing excessive conservativeness.

Who: Yan Miao, Hussein Darir, Sayan Mitra

arXiv cs.LG · importance 3/5 · robotics, ai-safety, simulation

item.title: Memory That Looks Forward: A Zero-Inference Prospective Term for Personal Memory Retrieval
item.description:
What: A retrieval method that boosts memory salience using a precomputed ledger of user commitments without adding query-time inference cost.

Why: It drastically improves future-oriented recall on hard tasks while preserving standard embedding relevance on routine queries.

Who: Jonathan Groff

arXiv cs.CL · importance 3/5 · llm, other

item.title: Did You Steal My Shot? Pioneering Camera Motion Plagiarism Detection in Generative Videos
item.description:
What: A new benchmark and detection method for identifying unauthorized replication of camera motion in generated videos.

Why: It introduces a vorticity-augmented optical flow representation that isolates camera movement from visual content to protect intellectual property.

Who: Chengguo Zhang, Ping Ping

arXiv cs.CV · importance 3/5 · general-ml, simulation

item.title: Transformers now runs llama.cpp quants
item.description:
What: Hugging Face Transformers now natively supports running llama.cpp quantized models.

Why: This enables easier deployment of highly compressed LLMs directly within the popular library ecosystem.

Who: Hugging Face

Hugging Face Blog · importance 3/5 · llm, training-infra

item.title: Jev introduces a new shape of LLM - System One, aka Decision Models
item.description:
What: A specialized language model that outputs structured numerical decisions and confidence scores instead of text.

Why: It enables highly efficient, low-cost classification and scoring tasks processed in parallel.

Who: TypeSafe AI

Simon Willison · importance 3/5 · llm, general-ml

item.description:

Who: NVIDIA

NVIDIA Technical Blog · importance 3/5 · training-infra, llm

item.description:

NVIDIA Technical Blog · importance 3/5 · llm, general-ml

item.description:

Who: OpenAI

TechCrunch AI · importance 3/5 · llm, general-ml

item.description:
What: xAI's Grok 4.6 large language model is now accessible through the Amazon Bedrock cloud platform.

Why: It introduces a 500K token context window and adjustable reasoning levels for agentic workflows and coding tasks.

Who: xAI

AWS Machine Learning · importance 3/5 · llm, foundational-models

item.title: Improving synthesis prediction of small molecules at scale with RetroChimera
item.description:
What: RetroChimera is a computational model designed to predict chemical synthesis pathways for small molecules.

Why: It scales up chemical reaction prediction to help accelerate development in materials science and medicine.

Who: Microsoft Research

Microsoft Research · importance 3/5 · general-ml

item.title: Turn Your Latest Observations Into Timely Weather Decisions With NVIDIA Earth-2
item.description:
What: NVIDIA released Earth-2 developer tools for integrating local sensor data into high-resolution weather forecasting pipelines.

Why: It bridges real-time observational inputs with AI-driven atmospheric modeling to enhance localized meteorological predictions.

Who: NVIDIA

NVIDIA Technical Blog · importance 3/5 · simulation, multimodal

item.title: Pruning LLMs Like a Physicist: Block Removal as an Ising Optimization Problem
item.description:
What: A novel method for compressing large language models by framing transformer block deletion as an Ising physics problem.

Why: It enables principled model pruning without requiring gradient updates during the reduction phase.

Who: Hugging Face

Hugging Face Blog · importance 3/5 · llm, general-ml

item.title: AI-inferred expressed well-being and collective-action discourse in climate-change campaigns on X
item.description:
What: An empirical study analyzing hundreds of thousands of social media posts to measure sentiment shifts during global climate events.

Why: It uncovers a divergence between positive affect and action-oriented language during environmental campaigns.

Who: Wentao Xu

arXiv cs.CL · importance 2/5 · general-ml, other

item.title: Enabling Vision and Cross-Modal Learning for Multimodal Stroke Recurrence Prediction: An Interpretable Two-Step Framework
item.description:
What: A two-step framework combining self-supervised pretraining and selective freezing to predict stroke recurrence from imaging and tabular data.

Why: It mitigates modality imbalance in medical datasets, preventing unimodal collapse and revealing clinically meaningful cross-modal interactions.

Who: Christian Gapp et al.

arXiv cs.CV · importance 2/5 · multimodal, interpretability, general-ml

item.title: Jun Kim, oMLX creator and maintainer, joins Hugging Face to support the MLX community
